svg.title: serve-kivi
svg.desc: Where the outliers are. Toy key cache (10 tokens × 12 channels) has two outlier channels, so KIVI quantizes keys per channel in groups of tokens and values per token, keeping the last R tokens in full precision (paper defaults: G = 32, R = 128, 2 bits). KVQuant quantizes keys before RoPE, because RoPE mixes channel pairs by position and smears the outlier channel. Reported LLaMA-7B Wikitext-2 perplexity: FP16 5.68, KVQuant 3-bit with 1% sparse outliers 5.75, uniform INT3 10.87.
